defmodule CryptoWorker do
  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @block_size 16
  @shutdown_timeout 5000

  defstruct [:key, :tasks, :shutting_down]

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(opts) do
    key = opts[:key] || :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(32)
    Process.flag(:trap_exit, true)
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{key: key, tasks: [], shutting_down: false}}
  end

  def decrypt_job(ciphertext_b64) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:decrypt, ciphertext_b64})
  end

  def handle_call({:decrypt, _ciphertext_b64}, _from, %{shutting_down: true} = state) do
    {:reply, {:error, :shutting_down}, state}
  end

  def handle_call({:decrypt, ciphertext_b64}, _from, state) do
    result = perform_decryption(ciphertext_b64, state.key)
    {:reply, result, state}
  end

  def terminate(_reason, state) do
    Logger.info("CryptoWorker shutting down, draining #{length(state.tasks)} tasks")
    drain_tasks(state.tasks, @shutdown_timeout)
    :ok
  end

  defp drain_tasks([], _timeout), do: :ok
  defp drain_tasks(tasks, timeout) do
    Enum.each(tasks, fn task ->
      Task.await(task, timeout)
    end)
  end

  defp perform_decryption(ciphertext_b64, _key) when not is_binary(ciphertext_b64) do
    {:error, :decryption_failed}
  end

  defp perform_decryption(ciphertext_b64, key) do
    with {:ok, ciphertext} <- Base.decode64(ciphertext_b64),
         {:ok, plaintext} <- aes_cbc_decrypt(ciphertext, key) do
      {:ok, plaintext}
    else
      {:error, _reason} -> {:error, :decryption_failed}
      :error -> {:error, :decryption_failed}
    end
  end

  defp aes_cbc_decrypt(ciphertext, key) when byte_size(ciphertext) > @block_size do
    <<iv::binary-size(@block_size), encrypted::binary>> = ciphertext

    case validate_ciphertext_length(encrypted) do
      :ok ->
        plaintext_padded = :crypto.crypto_one_time(:aes_256_cbc, key, iv, encrypted,
          [{:encrypt, false}, {:padding, :none}])
        remove_pkcs7_padding(plaintext_padded)
      {:error, _} -> {:error, :decryption_failed}
    end
  end

  defp aes_cbc_decrypt(_ciphertext, _key) do
    {:error, :decryption_failed}
  end

  defp validate_ciphertext_length(data) do
    if rem(byte_size(data), @block_size) == 0 do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :invalid_length}
    end
  end

  defp remove_pkcs7_padding(data) do
    data_size = byte_size(data)
    <<_prefix::binary-size(data_size - 1), last_byte>> = data
    pad_length = last_byte

    cond do
      pad_length == 0 ->
        {:error, :invalid_padding}
      pad_length > @block_size ->
        {:error, :invalid_padding}
      true ->
        padding_start = data_size - pad_length
        <<plaintext::binary-size(padding_start), padding::binary-size(pad_length)>> = data
        expected_padding = :binary.copy(<<pad_length>>, pad_length)

        if padding == expected_padding do
          {:ok, plaintext}
        else
          {:error, :invalid_padding}
        end
    end
  end
end

defmodule CryptoWorker.Router do
  use Plug.Router
  require Logger

  plug :match
  plug Plug.Parsers, parsers: [:json], json_decoder: Jason
  plug :dispatch

  post "/decrypt" do
    case conn.body_params do
      %{"ciphertext" => ct} when is_binary(ct) ->
        result = CryptoWorker.decrypt_job(ct)

        case result do
          {:ok, plaintext} ->
            send_resp(conn, 200, Jason.encode!(%{status: "ok", data: Base.encode64(plaintext)}))
          {:error, :shutting_down} ->
            send_resp(conn, 503, Jason.encode!(%{status: "error", reason: "service_unavailable"}))
          {:error, _} ->
            send_resp(conn, 400, Jason.encode!(%{status: "error", reason: "decryption_failed"}))
        end
      _ ->
        send_resp(conn, 400, Jason.encode!(%{status: "error", reason: "missing_ciphertext"}))
    end
  end

  match _ do
    send_resp(conn, 404, "not found")
  end
end
